title: 37. Numeracy & Number Systems: Decimal Place Value
description: A comprehensive mathematics curriculum progressing from foundational numeracy and core mathematical concepts to algebra, geometry, calculus, linear algebra, probability, statistics, discrete mathematics, optimization, mathematical foundations of AI, advanced pure mathematics, and emerging research methods.

questions.learningObjective: Determine the value of a digit in the tenths place of a decimal.
questions.question: What is the value of the digit \(7\) in \(0.74\)?
questions.explanation: In \(0.74\), the digit \(7\) is in the tenths place. A digit in the tenths place has a value equal to that digit multiplied by \(\frac{1}{10}\), so \(7\) tenths have a value of \(7\times 0.1=0.7\). Therefore, the value of the digit \(7\) is \(0.7\).
questions.hint: Identify the place of the digit first, then use that place to find its value.

questions.learningObjective: Identify the digit in the hundredths place of a decimal.
questions.question: In \(3.256\), which digit is in the hundredths place?
questions.explanation: In \(3.256\), the digits after the decimal point are \(2\), \(5\), and \(6\). The first digit after the decimal point is in the tenths place, the second is in the hundredths place, and the third is in the thousandths place. Therefore, the digit \(5\) is in the hundredths place.
questions.hint: Count the decimal places from left to right: tenths, hundredths, thousandths.

questions.learningObjective: Determine the value of a digit in the hundredths place of a decimal.
questions.question: What is the value of the digit \(4\) in \(5.049\)?
questions.explanation: In \(5.049\), the digit \(4\) is in the hundredths place. A digit in the hundredths place has a value equal to that digit multiplied by \(\frac{1}{100}\), so \(4\) hundredths have a value of \(4\times 0.01=0.04\). Therefore, the value of the digit \(4\) is \(0.04\).
questions.hint: Identify the place of the digit \(4\) first, then multiply the digit by the value of that place.

questions.learningObjective: Interpret the word form of a decimal and write it in standard form.
questions.question: Which decimal is read as "six and twenty-three hundredths"?
questions.explanation: The phrase "six and twenty-three hundredths" means \(6\) ones and \(23\) hundredths. Since \(23\) hundredths is written as \(0.23\), the decimal is \(6+0.23=6.23\). Therefore, the correct decimal is \(6.23\).
questions.hint: The word "hundredths" tells you how many places are after the decimal point.

questions.learningObjective: Determine the value of a digit in the tenths place of a decimal.
questions.question: In \(12.807\), what is the value of the digit \(8\)?
questions.explanation: In \(12.807\), the digit \(8\) is in the tenths place. A digit in the tenths place has a value equal to that digit multiplied by \(\frac{1}{10}\), so \(8\) tenths have a value of \(8\times 0.1=0.8\). Therefore, the value of the digit \(8\) is \(0.8\).
questions.hint: Find the place of the digit first, then multiply the digit by the value of that place.

questions.learningObjective: Identify the digit in the thousandths place of a decimal.
questions.question: Which digit is in the thousandths place in \(0.564\)?
questions.explanation: In \(0.564\), the digits after the decimal point are \(5\), \(6\), and \(4\). The first digit is in the tenths place, the second is in the hundredths place, and the third is in the thousandths place. Therefore, the digit \(4\) is in the thousandths place.
questions.hint: The thousandths place is three places to the right of the decimal point.

questions.learningObjective: Write a decimal with one decimal place (tenths) as a fraction.
questions.question: What is \(0.7\) written as a fraction?
questions.explanation: The decimal \(0.7\) has the digit \(7\) in the tenths place. A digit in the tenths place represents that many tenths, so \(0.7=\frac{7}{10}\). Therefore, the correct fraction is \(\frac{7}{10}\).
questions.hint: Find the place of the last digit; the name of that place tells you the denominator of the fraction.

questions.learningObjective: Identify the place value of a digit in a decimal.
questions.question: What is the place value of the digit \(2\) in \(4.125\)?
questions.explanation: In \(4.125\), the digits after the decimal point are \(1\), \(2\), and \(5\). The digit \(2\) is the second digit after the decimal point, so it is in the hundredths place. Therefore, the place value of the digit \(2\) is hundredths.
questions.hint: Count the places after the decimal point: tenths, hundredths, thousandths.

questions.learningObjective: Identify a decimal that has a given digit in the hundredths place.
questions.question: Which number has a \(6\) in the hundredths place?
questions.explanation: In \(3.56\), the digits after the decimal point are \(5\) and \(6\). The digit \(5\) is in the tenths place, and the digit \(6\) is in the hundredths place. Therefore, the number with a \(6\) in the hundredths place is \(3.56\).
questions.hint: The hundredths place is the second place to the right of the decimal point.

questions.learningObjective: Identify a decimal that has a given digit in the thousandths place.
questions.question: Which decimal has the digit \(9\) in the thousandths place?
questions.explanation: In \(2.839\), the digits after the decimal point are \(8\), \(3\), and \(9\). The digit \(8\) is in the tenths place, \(3\) is in the hundredths place, and \(9\) is in the thousandths place. Therefore, the decimal with \(9\) in the thousandths place is \(2.839\).
questions.hint: The thousandths place is the third place to the right of the decimal point.
